LOWMARK VALE — BLOCKOUT PLANNING MAP (TRUE SCALE)
1 SVG unit = 1 m · 3,456 × 3,072 m · 72 sectors of 384 m · 192 m quadrants
Sources: Lowmark terrain controls, regenerated regional and local surfaces, Director reference maps and conflict register
Director-approved working extent: 3,456 m E–W × 3,072 m N–S (10.616832 km²).
Origin: south-west frame corner = (0, 0). X east, Y north, metres.
Blender: X east / Y north / Z up. Unity: X east / Y up / Z north.
GLB terrain: X east / Y up / −Z north (terrain README).
SVG: world (x, y) is drawn at (x, −y); import puts origin at (0, 0).
Grid: 384 m sectors, columns A–I west to east, rows 01–08 south to north.
Quadrant index i = floor(x/192) 0–17, j = floor(y/192) 0–15.
Terrain: 8 m height_engineered.npy; contours 5 m (25 m index);
hillshade 2× exaggerated for reading only. Heights are technical

provisional compact site adjustments. The grid indexes placement.

1. Import the SVG. Use map_frame_3456x3072 to check a width of 3,456 m.
The frame's lower-left corner is world (0, 0); keep it there.
2. Or use the PNG as a top-ortho reference: 2 m per pixel; map frame
NW corner at pixel (260, 380) from the image's top-left.
3. Align terrain.glb / local GLBs on the same origin (no offsets).
4. Place buildings only inside envelopes, off channels and crossings;
leave BLOCKED features (red) as empty placeholders.
5. Record any new building position in world metres + sector ID.

g.inkscape:label: 14 Settlement guidance, conflicts, unanchored sites
g.text: SETTLEMENT BLOCKOUT GUIDANCE (building totals are ESTIMATES: proposed planning targets from the 2026-11-06 terrain mission, not canon)
Compact Hall and Depot positions are provisional (TC-01–05).
Lower shoulder core; Rebirth Fields remain untraced.
Conditional stilt sites. Causeways and staging unbuilt.
Working crossing envelope reaches main river (TC-13).
Offset yard candidate; hydraulic and machinery layout open.

Regional screen = normal-stage / outside +1.5 m scenario candidate count (terrain README); local = 2 m normal / scenario floor (LOCAL_README). Screens assume 120–160 m² mean roofs; they are capacity checks, not plot plans. Envelope axes are E–W × N–S full diameters.
Hall and Depot use provisional compact positions. The civic budget and functional interfaces still require local design.
CONFLICTS AND PROVISIONAL ITEMS (Lowmark Terrain / Narrative Conflict Register TC-xx; NC = new, found while building this sheet)
BLOCKS · Compact Hall site; direct water gate, cistern and bridge north stair remain unbuilt.
Granary and toll-facing yard have no approved placement.
Depot remains uphill. Chute and below-toll slack-water exit need a local layout.
Technical route crossing only. Bridge, stairs and transitions are unbuilt.
Hall-to-mouth alignment is a straight-distance diagnostic; towpath still unbuilt.
Tail race still meets the common outfall; separate wartime spur unresolved.
Static mill head does not establish draft, pulses or reverse flow.
Working yard offset from the race. Pond, wheel and gates remain unbuilt.
BLOCKS · Cut mouth, mill tail and Bramblelock share weir_up; no length for MQ4 chase between them.
The straight exceeds the 60–90 second quest beat. See route measurements.
The natural fen outlet remains open in the static baseline.
Reedmere requires stilts; staging, causeways and evacuation remain unbuilt.
Provisional landing envelope reaches main-river bank; crossing and road-head view untested.
Regional uphill line is schematic; the quest's twenty-step site is unplaced.
Rebirth Fields extent and seepage remain unresolved.
Falls approach requires local switchbacks and Listening Steps.
Local fen-edge channel at Mantle Shrine remains untraced.
See updated route measurements for pacing and unbuilt crossings.
Greyharrow upper capacity and civic outworks budget remain unresolved.
Whispering Door map anchor and Rebirth Fields outfall relationship need review.
Western arm retained as terminal backwater profile pending topology ruling.
